critical_operation.desc: The response handler uses the flawed HTML classification to decide whether to set the CSP sandbox header; a whitespace-prefixed MIME type skips this branch.

entry_point.desc: Webhook responseHeaders are evaluated from workflow configuration and each user-controlled value is inserted unchanged into the response-header map.

trace.desc: The workflow-controlled responseHeaders values enter the response map without whitespace normalization.
The evaluated headers are packaged into the static webhook response returned to the common response handler.
The request handler receives the webhook result and forwards its attacker-controlled headers to the response-sending path.
The static response branch extracts the headers and sends them to the shared header writer.
The header writer copies the configured Content-Type value unchanged onto the Express response.
HTML classification lowercases but does not trim Content-Type, so a leading space makes the startsWith checks return false.
The false HTML classification makes needsSandbox false and suppresses the CSP sandbox header that would contain the response.
